name: SCP: Short Story
detailed_description:
Another end of the world - since it is the SCP universe, you should not be surprised. This time, almost all living forms are destroyed. Some turned into holograms - aggressive and dangerous entities that will try to kill everyone who passes by. The only surviving remains are, of course, the SCP bunker with a small group of people.
In this FPS, you are playing as one of the last Foundation soldiers. Your task is simple - retrieve documents that will help your scientists create a portal out of this world. To get these papers, you will need to go through desert-like fields, an abandoned city, and empty corridors of the Site-17.
Supplies are running out pretty fast, so you will have to keep an eye on them and always search remaining stashes across your path. Ammo, medkits, pills - all of that will help you survive and complete the mission.
Do not underestimate holograms - they can be shot from your rifle, but if you hesitate for a small amount of seconds, they will teleport right before your face and kill you within seconds.

short_description: SCP: Short Story is a first-person shooter set in a world where the K-class scenario destroyed almost every living form. You’ll have to get through this dead world, retrieve essential documents from Site-17, and most importantly - do not get killed by what survived.
